id.description:
Strong-typed identifier of a project — the scope unit for runs, work items,
settings and role assignments.

envClass.description:
Environment-class id the scalar source repository binds to (catalog id, e.g. `"net10-sdk-bun"`);
null when the project has no confirmed class. Mirrors the
`Project.EnvClass` stand-in (add-worker-environments task 2.2):
an empty binding means implement work items for the project are not claimable.

description:
Read model of a project — everything the operational UI needs, nothing
internal. Identity fields arrive display-ready: the colour is lower-case
`#rrggbb`, tags are trimmed/lower-cased/deduplicated, the icon is an
opaque string (emoji or URL) to render verbatim.
